name: designer_severity_router
why: Harder: a three-way decision with different work on each arm, plus a failure path.
goal: Build a playbook that runs when an alert is created and routes it by severity. Critical: create an incident from the alert and email soc-leads@example.com. High: set the alert's status to In Progress and add a comment saying it needs tier 2 review. Anything else: close the alert. If creating the incident fails, the playbook should still email soc-leads@example.com saying it failed, instead of just stopping.

requirements.note: trigger is not the designer's own record
